                                    Materialized view "public.mv_orders"
   Column    |  Type   | Collation | Nullable | Default | Storage | Compression | Stats target | Description 
-------------+---------+-----------+----------+---------+---------+-------------+--------------+-------------
 customer_id | integer |           |          |         | plain   |             |              | 
 n           | bigint  |           |          |         | plain   |             |              | 
 total       | numeric |           |          |         | main    |             |              | 
Indexes:
    "mv_orders_customer" UNIQUE, btree (customer_id)
View definition:
 SELECT customer_id,
    count(*) AS n,
    sum(price) AS total
   FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id;
Access method: heap
Options: fillfactor=90
